slides.title: Ask before it turns *bitter*.
slides.sub: Resentment is often a need nobody heard.

slides.title: Notice the small sting.
slides.body: The sigh when they're late again. The scorekeeping in your head. That's usually a need, still unspoken.

slides.title: Hints aren't asks.
slides.body: Hoping they'll notice isn't the same as saying it. People can't meet a need they don't know about.

slides.title: Say it small and early.
slides.body: "Could you text if you're running late? It helps me." One need, one sentence, before it builds.

slides.title: Try it this week.
slides.body: Find one thing you keep quietly resenting. Ask: what do I need here? Then say it in one plain sentence.
